scope: actual assistant paired order-balanced pilot; two pairs, no population speedup inference
model: same active thread; independent model identity/settings/usage telemetry unavailable
deadline: latest capture_ns +25 seconds; expired input requires explicit recovery
policy: inspect initial image; visually aim with bounded directional holds then fire; no engine telemetry before finish

arms.separate: action returns text and feedback metadata; image fetched in next functions call
arms.combined: action returns same text and feedback metadata plus image in same functions call

initial_delivery: combined startup and initial image in both arms
primary: task success; first acceptance to finish-command receipt; include failed and recovery attempts
